description: This file defines constants, types, and functions related to model configurations and URLs for ZAI models, including model catalog entries, default costs, and URL resolution functions.

methods.name: resolveZaiBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the base URL for ZAI services based on an optional endpoint string.

methods.name: buildZaiModelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs a model definition configuration object based on provided parameters and the model catalog.
